pairs.subject: document-text-extraction
pairs.evidence: src/features/vault/shared/vector/tabs/DocumentsTab.tsx:172 The document listing surfaces unreadable pages as a bare cardinality instead of preserving and showing the specific page locus or ranges, and leaks a stage-one emptiness heuristic as a user-facing warning without optical recognition confirmation or escalation.

techniques.evidence: src/features/vault/shared/vector/tabs/DocumentsTab.tsx:172 Reduces unreadable pages to a bare count in a warning rather than presenting the page range locus to the user.
src/features/vault/shared/vector/search/SearchResultCard.tsx:19 Collapses extraction quality into a boolean threshold over a confidence float rather than using discrete action-routing yield bands.
src/features/vault/shared/vector/partialConfidence.ts:13 Threshold separating partial from full extraction is hardcoded without constructed defect fixtures or precision-recall curve validation.
src/features/vault/shared/vector/extract/EntityTable.tsx:104 Surfaces stage-one extraction confidence suspicion directly to the user as a warning badge without optical confirmation.
src/features/vault/shared/vector/tabs/DocumentsTab.tsx:168 Surfaces unreadable pages passively with no escalation path to optical character recognition.
src/features/vault/shared/vector/ingest/IngestTextModal.tsx:24 Permits unbounded text submission without a maximum payload cap or structural amplification guard.
